changelog:
v4.5.2 — June 2026

Multi-LLM routing: Elite modes now use Claude Sonnet 4.6 for superior analysis quality; standard modes use Claude Haiku for speed
Sources, confidence, and market_score promoted to root level of response for programmatic trust validation (M2M)
M2M Trust Protocol added to mcp.json, agent-card, discovery resources, and llms-full.txt — includes agent decision pipeline and machine_trust_protocol
Trial key endpoint: GET /api-keys/trial — 5 free calls, no wallet required
Security: removed test_valid payment bypass — all calls now require verified on-chain payment or valid key
Batch endpoint now accepts X-SESSION and X-API-KEY in addition to x402
Path-aware 422 handlers with exact schema examples per endpoint
Budget guidance field added to market_entry_execution mode
JSON truncation recovery — no more parse_error on large outputs
Data privacy warning added to skill description and documentation
